description: The real 16 x 16 gamma matrices of the author's notebook (T16, built from the tau matrices), re-constructed from the author's formulas by Revision/algebra/wolfram/RevisionAlgebra.wl and in the author's coordinates x0..x7 (SPEC section 2): gamma^(xk) = T16[k], k = 0..7. x0 = the hidden direction; x1, x2, x3 = 3-space; x4 = time; x5, x6, x7 = the exponentially deflating extra times.
encoding: Every matrix is a list of rows (row index first). An exact rational is a JSON integer when it is an integer and otherwise a JSON string "p/q" in lowest terms with q > 0. A complex matrix is an object {"re": real part, "im": imaginary part}. Indices a, b = 0..7 of gamma, eta and S stand for x0..x7.

definitions.gamma: gamma[a] = gamma^(x_a) = T16[a]; {gamma^a, gamma^b} = 2 eta^ab I16
definitions.C: C = gamma^(x0) gamma^(x1) gamma^(x2) gamma^(x3) (the notebook's sigma16); Dirac adjoint Psibar = Psi^dagger C
definitions.Gamma: Gamma = gamma^(x0) gamma^(x1) ... gamma^(x7) (the notebook's T16[8]) = diag(-I8, I8)
